reason: The Codex app-server transport reused the 4 MiB MCP bound as the stdio StreamReader limit, so one longer line (Codex echoes a user's image data URL in item/started and item/completed, a command's aggregatedOutput, or the full thread history in a thread/resume response) made readline raise and the reader ended the transport and killed the process; websocket and unix endpoints used the 1 MiB websockets default and closed with 1009. _CodexRpc now splits stdout lines itself up to a Codex-specific 256 MiB bound and drops a single over-limit line with a diagnostic (failing the request whose response it was) instead of ending the transport, both websocket connects pass max_size, and thread/resume sends excludeTurns because Nebula never reads thread.turns. Transport closed/failed errors now carry the redacted, ANSI-stripped stderr tail (bounded to survive the 1,000-character operator error cap). The Codex `error` notification is handled (willRetry becomes a Reconnecting warning notice, other errors an info-level record ahead of the failed turn/completed that reports them), hook notifications read id/eventName/status from the nested run so blocked or failed hooks show as failed, terminal interaction shows the stdin sent, and server requests Nebula does not implement get a JSON-RPC -32601 reply instead of silence that left Codex waiting forever. tests/v3/test_codex_transport.py (16 tests, all failing on origin/main) proves it with real subprocess, websocket and unix-socket transports plus scripted notifications; the selected test_harness_adapters.py tests are the three whose fake stdout was updated from readline to read and the existing tests that drive the spawn path, the reader and handled server requests.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through harnesses.py) does not run a Codex app-server, large frames or server requests; the Python tests drive the transport directly. test_harness_adapters.py, test_harnesses.py, test_harness_commands.py, test_harness_connection_state.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_codex_turn_outcomes.py and test_harness_stopped_turns.py were run locally in full and pass but are not selected. No full suites.
